pages.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE independent landscape 4:3 picture-book page, NOT a grid, NO lettering, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos or watermark. Reference image is the approved storyboard: match its original kangaroo identity and hand-painted tissue-paper collage style, but DO NOT reproduce any text. Warm sunflower yellow #F4C335 with ochre drybrush variations, cream muzzle/belly and visible curved kangaroo pouch opening, small teal neckerchief, tall tapered ears with terracotta interiors, elongated muzzle and tiny dark nose, small simple dark eyes, little forearms, large haunches, distinctly long hind feet and thick long tapering tail. Clear KANGAROO anatomy. Same character and proportions every time. Authentic thin painted paper collage, varied acrylic brush textures on individual cut paper pieces, natural uneven hand-cut contours, flat collage, no thick outlines, no 3D or sculpted paper, no heavy shadows, no uniform noise texture. Pure white background. Necessary minimal props in the same medium. Full body including ear tips, both feet and tail comfortably within frame. Keep the top 23% of the canvas completely blank pure white for HTML typography to be added later. Put all illustration below that top area, extending from roughly 27% to 93% height, comfortable side margins. Composition balanced, expressive gestures and childlike warmth. No text anywhere, especially no copied storyboard text. Cover: smiling kangaroo at lower center-left proudly holds a coral-red toothbrush upright in one hand. Other little forearm lifted with cheerful anticipation. Full ears, thick long curved tail and both very long feet visible. Two tiny ochre cut-paper sparkles at the sides, below the reserved top area. No sink or other props.
